# Virool

> Virool is a native video advertising platform that distributes branded video content
> ("advertainment") across the open web for brands, agencies and publishers. It pairs a
> proprietary data-management platform of roughly 450 million unique profiles for granular
> audience targeting with native video placement technology, and a real-time performance
> dashboard that includes emotional insight tracking (eIQ). Virool serves advertisers and
> publishers through self-service campaign and monetization dashboards.

**This file was GENERATED by API Evangelist from the catalog profile at
https://github.com/api-evangelist/virool — it is NOT published by Virool.**
Virool serves no /llms.txt of its own (https://virool.com/llms.txt returns 404).

## API status — read this first

Virool publishes **no public API, no developer portal, no SDK and no machine-readable
contract.** As of 2026-08-12:

- No `/docs`, `/developers`, `/developer`, `/api`, `/api-docs`, `/openapi.json`,
  `/swagger.json` path exists on virool.com — every one returns HTTP 404.
- The API host Virool developers were historically pointed at,
  `http://api.virool.com/api/v1`, **no longer resolves (NXDOMAIN)**.
- No `/.well-known/` discovery document is served on either virool.com or www.virool.com
  (18 paths probed, 18 x HTTP 404).
- No A2A agent card, no MCP server, no GraphQL endpoint, no AsyncAPI, no webhook catalog.
- No first-party client library exists in npm, PyPI, RubyGems, Packagist, crates.io,
  Maven Central or pkg.go.dev.

The only machine-facing integration Virool documents is **IAB VAST** ad-tag placement for
publishers — an ad-serving standard, not an API contract.

## Products

- [Advertisers](https://www.virool.com/advertiser): campaign distribution for branded
  video across the open web, with audience targeting from Virool's DMP.
- [Publishers](https://www.virool.com/publisher): monetization of video inventory, priced
  on a CPM or CPV basis. Units include InLine outstream, vertical video and pre-roll VAST
  placement in an existing waterfall.
- [InLine native unit](https://www.virool.com/inline): outstream in-article video unit,
  described by Virool as VAST compliant.
- [Vertical Reveal](https://www.virool.com/vertical-reveal): vertical video ad unit.
- [eIQ](https://www.virool.com/eiq): emotional insight measurement on video creative.

## Pricing

No plan tiers are published; https://virool.com/pricing returns 404. Inventory is sold on
a CPM or CPV basis with no published rates, floors or minimum spend. Commercial terms are
arranged through signup or the contact form.

## For agents

There is nothing here to call. Do not attempt to construct requests against
`api.virool.com` — the host does not exist. Any Virool "API" reference found in a
third-party API directory describes a surface that has been retired.
